      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 100
    },
    "release_verdict": {
      "description": "Starts with one of BLOCKED, INCOMPLETE_SCAN, REVIEW_REQUIRED, STATIC_CHECKS_PASSED or RELEASE_AUDIT_PASSED, followed by an explanation in parentheses that varies between runs - match the leading word, never the whole string. STATIC_CHECKS_PASSED is NOT a release-readiness claim: only --profile release, with every release stage actually completed, can return RELEASE_AUDIT_PASSED. With --diff, a changeset with no scannable source returns 'NO CODE CHANGES TO REVIEW (...)'.",
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "examples": [
        "BLOCKED (Fix Critical/High findings before publishing)",
        "INCOMPLETE_SCAN (0 source files scanned - cannot certify readiness)",
        "INCOMPLETE_SCAN (1 check skipped/offline: No Build Output Found; re-run with those stages available)",
        "REVIEW_REQUIRED (2 finding(s) need a human decision before release)",
        "STATIC_CHECKS_PASSED (the static checks that ran found nothing - this is NOT a release-readiness verdict; run --profile release)",
        "RELEASE_AUDIT_PASSED (source, dependencies, git history and shipped artifacts all audited with no findings)",
        "NO CODE CHANGES TO REVIEW (diff contained no scannable source files)"
      ]
    },
    "summary_counts": {
      "description": "Finding tallies by severity and by domain.",
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "CRITICAL",
        "HIGH",
        "MEDIUM",
        "LOW",
        "SECURITY_TOTAL",
        "UI_UX_TOTAL",
        "SUPPLY_CHAIN_TOTAL",
        "ARTIFACT_TOTAL",
        "HISTORY_TOTAL",

        "PAYMENTS_TOTAL",
        "RELIABILITY_TOTAL"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "CRITICAL": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },

          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0

        "MEDIUM": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "LOW": {

          "minimum": 0

      }
    },
    "dependencies_parsed": {

        }
      }
    },
    "skipped_checks": {
      "description": "Checks that could not run (offline mode, unreachable URL or database, unopenable package). Same shape as a finding, but these are coverage gaps: they are excluded from readiness_score and summary_counts, and their presence forces release_verdict to INCOMPLETE.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/finding"
      }
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "finding": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "rule_id",
        "domain",
        "severity",
        "title",
        "file",
        "line",
        "snippet",
        "cwe_or_standard",
        "remediation",
        "confidence",
        "fingerprint",
        "kind",
        "status"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "rule_id": {
          "description": "Stable rule identifier. SEC/UX/LIVE are source and live-posture rules; PAY is payments and business logic; REL is backend reliability and scale; FLOW is data-flow (taint) analysis; DEP is dependency vulnerabilities; ART is build-artifact and mobile-package findings; HIST is git-history forensics; COV is something the scanner declined to read; ENG is an external engine that did not run. EXT-<ENGINE>:<id> is a finding imported from an external engine, keeping that engine's own rule id. A rule id ending in -00 is always a coverage gap, never a defect.",
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:SEC|UX|LIVE|DEP|ART|HIST|GIT|FLOW|PAY|REL|COV|ENG)-[0-9]{2}[A-Z]?|EXT-[A-Z0-9-]+:.+)$"
        },
        "domain": {
          "description": "COVERAGE marks something that was not examined, not a defect. EXTERNAL marks a finding imported from an installed third-party engine, which keeps that engine's own rule id behind an EXT-<ENGINE>: prefix.",
          "enum": [
            "SECURITY",
            "UI_UX",
            "PAYMENTS",
            "RELIABILITY",
            "SUPPLY_CHAIN",
            "ARTIFACT",
            "HISTORY",
            "DATAFLOW",
            "COVERAGE",
            "EXTERNAL"
          ]
        },
        "severity": {
          "description": "Impact rating used by the Release Readiness Score.",
          "enum": [
            "CRITICAL",
            "HIGH",
            "MEDIUM",
            "LOW"
          ]
        },
        "title": {
          "description": "Short human-readable description of the defect.",
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "file": {
          "description": "Repository-relative file path, or the probed URL for live posture findings.",
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "line": {
          "description": "1-indexed line number, or 0 for findings that are not tied to a source line (live URL checks).",
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "snippet": {
          "description": "Trimmed evidence excerpt. Credentials are always redacted (public provider prefix and length only) so reports are safe to commit and share.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "cwe_or_standard": {
          "description": "Cited authority: a CWE ID, an OWASP Top 10 category, or a WCAG 2.2 success criterion.",
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "remediation": {
          "description": "Concrete, actionable fix instruction.",
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "confidence": {
          "description": "Scanner confidence before the adversarial Skeptic stage reviews the claim.",
          "enum": [
            "HIGH",
            "MEDIUM",
            "LOW"
          ],
          "default": "HIGH"
        },
        "fingerprint": {
          "description": "Stable 16-hex-character id derived from rule, file and normalised evidence. Used for baseline suppression and SARIF partialFingerprints; survives line-number shifts.",
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        },
        "kind": {
          "description": "'finding' is a real defect that counts toward the score. 'skipped_check' is a check that could not run - it never affects the score and forces an INCOMPLETE verdict.",
          "enum": [
            "finding",
            "skipped_check"
          ],
          "default": "finding"
        },
        "status": {
          "description": "VULNERABILITY is a real defect that counts toward the score. SKIPPED and SCAN_ERROR are coverage gaps: they never affect the score and they make release_verdict INCOMPLETE_SCAN unless a CRITICAL or HIGH finding already makes it BLOCKED.",
          "enum": [
            "VULNERABILITY",
            "SKIPPED",
            "SCAN_ERROR"
          ],
          "default": "VULNERABILITY"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
